scope: Repository-controlled source, configuration, contracts, migrations, tests, UI, container definitions, infrastructure declarations and documentation

defects.finding: Root release identity was not converged after UI modernisation.
defects.resolution: Advanced the canonical repository to 1.0.0-converged and made convergence proof part of the root command surface.

defects.finding: No single final convergence command covered inherited proof plus convergence-specific assertions.
No machine-readable repository defect register existed.
Unresolved implementation markers could re-enter without a dedicated convergence control.
defects.resolution: Added recursive marker inspection across executable and configuration files.

defects.finding: Core workload convergence was not asserted by the final gate.
defects.resolution: Added mandatory topology assertions for the 11 core Compose workloads.

defects.finding: The white-background/no-gradient policy was documented but not enforced by the convergence gate.
defects.resolution: Added automated gradient prohibition and white-background assertion.

defects.finding: No final repository-wide convergence report joined remediation status, proof and residual external gates.
Repository defects and external commissioning evidence were previously easy to conflate.
defects.resolution: Separated the zero repository-defect register from the residual external dependency register.

defects.title: Service containers running as root
defects.resolution: Added USER node to all affected production service Dockerfiles.

defects.title: Convergence gate hard-coded to prior release version
defects.resolution: Updated release-candidate version convergence to accept subsequent certified release candidates.
